text: Paperwork can be exhausting when typing is difficult. UNBOUND Access asks one question at a time.
This edited demo uses real app screens, fictional typed answers, and synthetic narration. It is not continuous voice capture.
Optional Meta Llama three point two, with three billion parameters, runs in the browser and proposes each question's answer type.
For this authored bicycle repair form, the smaller one billion parameter model matched two of eight types and was rejected.

chapter: The newer run passed source checks
text: The three billion parameter model matched all eight. Exact requests and unchanged responses are saved in the public repository.
That is one development case, not an independent accuracy benchmark. CPU extraction took about one hundred sixty three seconds.

chapter: Trace the proposed types to their source
text: The source asks for a contact name, an email, a date, a budget, a problem description, and three address rows.

kind: Application links from explicit source wording
text: Both home rows refer to one fact. The workshop is a different fact, even though all three ask for an address.
The app derives labels, pages, required flags, and repeated facts from the source. Those are not credited as model output.

kind: Saved-schema replay · no new AI call
text: This screen replays that saved proposal through manual import. The person checks every question and shared fact before approving it.

chapter: A real answer call: zero dollars
text: Every answer still needs confirmation. A separate real Meta call interpreted zero dollars as zero, in about ninety five seconds.
The model never saves that proposal automatically. The person can cancel it, correct it, or confirm it.
Here, correcting the home address proposes both copies together. Confirmation changes them to one hundred one Practice Street.
The workshop stays at nine hundred Separate Venue Road. A shared fact never silently becomes somebody else's address.
After reviewing the answers, the person checks the acknowledgement and prepares the PDF. Save and Open links remain available.
This is the actual one page file downloaded in the earlier three billion parameter browser workflow, with fictional information.

kind: Exact crops from the actual PDF
text: The file preserved both corrected home addresses, the separate workshop address, and the zero budget. Nothing was signed or submitted.
The latest reliability checks kept sixty long corrections through a refresh. Contradictory follow up answers block a reviewed record.
One hundred seven automated checks pass. These are engineering tests, not model accuracy or proof of universal accessibility.

chapter: Optional, with a clear download cost
text: The three billion parameter model is an optional two point zero two gigabyte download. No API key, payment card, or paid fallback is needed.
A tester reported the repaired phone PDF download worked. Full hands free completion and measured usability remain unverified.

kind: App, raw receipts and public source
text: Try the app, review the original model receipts, and inspect the source. Every confirmed answer stays under the person's control.
